[[File:Flying Osprey.jpg|thumb|The wreck of the ''Flying Osprey''.]]

'''''Flying Osprey''''' was a [[High elf|high elven]] destroyer of the [[Thalassian navy]] that accompanied [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiras]]' [[Lost Fleet|Third Fleet]] during the [[Second War]]. The elven vessel was carrying a load of [[Lightforge Iron]] and had joined the Third Fleet for protection.

During a battle between the [[Alliance of Lordaeron|Alliance]] and [[Old Horde|Horde]] naval forces off the coast of the [[Wetlands]] of [[Khaz Modan]], the Third Fleet was destroyed by the [[Dragonmaw clan]] and their subservient [[red dragon]]s. The vessel's wreckage remains off the coast of the Wetlands to this day, to the south of [[Menethil Harbor]] in the entrance of [[Menethil Bay]].

Members of the [[Alliance]], aiding the town of [[Darkshire]] in their battle against [[Morbent Fel]], are sent to locate '''Flying Osprey'''s wreckage and retrieve the shipment of Lightforge Iron so that it can be used to create [[Morbent's Bane|a weapon]] that will destroy the evil [[necromancer]].<ref>[[The Doomed Fleet]]</ref><ref>[[Lightforge Iron]]</ref><ref>[[Armed and Ready]]</ref>
